scenarios.title: A｜最终找到预订
scenarios.setting: 在“有预约但找不到记录”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“最终找到预订”。

turns.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?

turns.prompt: 关于「有预约但找不到记录」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, I have a reservation for two at 7:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have a reservation for two at 7:30.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: Yes, it’s under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, it’s under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: We booked a table for 7:30 under the name Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: We booked a table for 7:30 under the name Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under the name”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Yes. The reservation should be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. The reservation should be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

turns.text: I’m sorry, I don’t see that name on the list.

turns.prompt: 你想请餐厅再次核对已有的预订，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you check again, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check again, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: It should definitely be under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: It should definitely be under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I have the confirmation here on my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the confirmation here on my phone.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: Could it be under my friend’s name instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could it be under my friend’s name instead?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: But I definitely booked it!

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check again, please?
feedback.explanation: 这句能坚持自己有预约；出示确认信息比单纯强调“definitely”更便于找到记录。

turns.prompt: 对方需要查看资料或物品，你会怎样配合？

choices.text: Of course. Here it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Here it is.
feedback.explanation: “here it is”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Sure. This is the confirmation email I received.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. This is the confirmation email I received.
feedback.explanation: “confirmation email”指确认邮件，用来核对办理结果。

choices.text: Yes. It says 7:30 tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. It says 7:30 tonight.
feedback.explanation: “it says”引用屏幕、通知或记录上的内容，便于一起核对信息来源。

turns.text: Ah, I found it. It was entered under your first name.

turns.prompt: 你想让对方放轻松，表示理解或不介意，会怎么说？

choices.text: No problem. I’m glad you found it.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. I’m glad you found it.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Great, thank you for checking.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for checking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for sorting that out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for sorting that out.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

turns.text: Your table is ready. Right this way.

scenarios.title: B｜需要等待
scenarios.setting: 在“有预约但找不到记录”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“需要等待”。

turns.text: I can see your reservation now, but unfortunately your table isn’t ready yet.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: About how long will the wait be?

feedback.naturalExpression: About how long will the wait be?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Do you know when the table will be ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know when the table will be ready?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: That’s okay. How long do you think it’ll take?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s okay. How long do you think it’ll take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: We had a reservation for 7:30. Is there much of a delay?

feedback.naturalExpression: We had a reservation for 7:30. Is there much of a delay?
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

turns.text: It should be about fifteen minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「有预约但找不到记录」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s fine. We’ll wait.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. We’ll wait.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Okay. Is there somewhere we can sit while we wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Is there somewhere we can sit while we wait?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Could you let us know as soon as the table is ready?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you let us know as soon as the table is ready?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can we wait at the bar?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we wait at the bar?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: Of course. You’re welcome to wait at the bar.

turns.prompt: 关于「有预约但找不到记录」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. We’ll wait there.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. We’ll wait there.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Perfect. Please let us know when the table is ready.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Please let us know when the table is ready.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

scenarios.title: C｜餐厅无法提供座位
scenarios.setting: 在“有预约但找不到记录”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“餐厅无法提供座位”。

turns.text: I’m very sorry, but we’ve had a problem with our reservation system, and we don’t have a table available for you.

turns.prompt: 你想说明自己已有确认的预订，请对方核查，会怎么说？

choices.text: I see. But I do have a confirmed reservation for 7:30.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. But I do have a confirmed reservation for 7:30.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: I have the confirmation right here. What can we do?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the confirmation right here. What can we do?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Is there any way you could still accommodate us tonight?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way you could still accommodate us tonight?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Could you check whether another table might become available soon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether another table might become available soon?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: That’s your problem, not mine.

feedback.naturalExpression: I see. But I do have a confirmed reservation for 7:30.
feedback.explanation: 这句把问题完全推给对方，容易让协商变成争执；强调已有确认的预订，再请求解决办法更有效。

turns.text: I understand. I’m very sorry. The earliest table we can offer is at 9:00.

turns.prompt: 你想商量等待之外是否有更早入座的办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s quite a bit later. Is there anything earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s quite a bit later. Is there anything earlier?
feedback.explanation: “quite a bit”表示相当多或不少，适合口语中描述程度。

choices.text: Would it be possible to seat us at the bar instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be possible to seat us at the bar instead?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: Could you put us first on the waiting list?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you put us first on the waiting list?
feedback.explanation: “waiting list”是候补名单；没有现成名额时，可以询问能否登记候补。

choices.text: Is there anything else you can offer us?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else you can offer us?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

turns.text: We could seat you at the bar in about twenty minutes.

turns.prompt: 关于「有预约但找不到记录」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: That would be fine. We’ll take the bar seats.

feedback.naturalExpression: That would be fine. We’ll take the bar seats.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Twenty minutes works for us. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Twenty minutes works for us. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: “works for us”表示时间或安排合适，让对方知道可以确定下来。
